items.title: 68426_Nellie Lutcher oral history interview
items.q: We also had, from Lake Charles we had -- let's see, Eldridge Joe, Snake Griffin -- oh, from Apaloosa, Louisiana we had a marvelous saxophone player by the name of Lawrence Emerson

ctx.x: He played drums. Eldridge Joe. Then we had Snake Griffin. Snake was a saxophone player, a tenor saxophone player. We also had, from Lake Charles we had -- let's see, Eldridge Joe, Snake Griffin -- oh, from Apaloosa, Louisiana we had a marvelous saxophone player by the name of Lawrence Emerson who later sort of got away from the music business and became an educator. He was the principal of a school. I think he just retired a couple of years (ago). Down in the little city of Apaloosa, Louisiana. And then I…
I think you mentioned on the earlier tape that Eldridge Joe later played with what orchestra, Don Abbott?
